dish: Kushiro zangi (marinated fried chicken with spiced dipping sauce)
w: Said to be the birthplace of zangi (1960) — chicken marinated in about ten seasonings, fried and eaten with a spiced sauce.

dish: spakatsu (spaghetti with meat sauce and a pork cutlet on a sizzling iron plate)
n: Restaurant Izumiya Sōhonten, Kushiro (レストラン泉屋 総本店)
w: Kushiro's yōshoku house since 1954 and home of the spakatsu — its meat sauce is the taste of the dish, now even sold retort-packed.

n: New Montblanc, Nemuro (ニューモンブラン)
w: The original escalope shop: the dish was born around 1963 at Nemuro's 'Montblanc' and carried on here by a former cook — butter rice under a pork cutlet and demi-glace.

dish: yaki-shōyu ramen with Rishiri kombu broth
n: Rishiri Ramen Miraku (利尻らーめん味楽)
address: 67 Kutsugata-honmachi, Rishiri, Rishiri District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Island ramen that made the magazines and TV — scorched-soy broth built on generous Rishiri kelp; the Rishiri main shop was a Michelin Bib Gourmand in the Hokkaido special edition. Lunch 11:30–14:00.
